products: quarter, half and whole beef (roasts, steaks, stew meat, ground beef)

feeding_claim.verbatim: Nearly everything our cattle eat is a local plant product.

availability.note: Waitlist for fall 2026 or 2027 beef; join by emailing beef@saguarojuniper.org.

notes: Non-profit 501(c)(3) conservation and community cattle ranch on the Middle San Pedro River near Cascabel. Older site saguaro-juniper.com/food/beef.html is headed Saguaro Juniper Natural Grass-fed Beef; current site says no urea or animal products fed and does not mention grain or finishing, so category grass-fed. Beef is picked up cut, wrapped and frozen in Tucson or Willcox, not at the ranch; farm-pickup used as the closest channel. January 2026 price $5 per lb hanging weight plus packing house fee.
